name: discipline
description: Discipline 自律 —— 课程表 · 专注 · 待办 · 成就（PWA + Android APK）

scripts.build: npm run icons && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/write-version.mjs
scripts.build:gh-pages: npm run icons && tsc --noEmit && vite build --base=./ && node scripts/write-version.mjs
scripts.build:html: npm run icons && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.singlefile.config.ts && node scripts/copy-html.mjs && node scripts/write-version.mjs
scripts.cap:add: npm run build && cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.deploy:gh-pages: npm run build:gh-pages && gh-pages -d dist -b gh-pages
